name: io.github.makash/feedmyagent
description: Technology intelligence feed for AI agents: tech stack, compliance, security.

environmentVariables.name: FEEDMYAGENT_API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: FeedMyAgent API base URL. Optional — defaults to https://api.feedmyagent.com

environmentVariables.name: FEEDMYAGENT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional API key. If absent, the server self-provisions a free key on first run (stored in ~/.config/feedmyagent/). Manual: POST https://api.feedmyagent.com/keys with {"owner": "your-agent-name"}
